title: Python SCHC sender test duplicates the same oversized assertion
description: test_fragment_sender_rejects_by_default contains two identical assertions using payload MAX_SCHC_PACKET+1 and receiver_limit=MAX_SCHC_PACKET. The duplicate adds no coverage and obscures the missing receiver-limit boundary cases found in the same review.
acceptance_criteria: Remove the duplicate assertion or replace it with a distinct receiver-limit/profile boundary case. The focused sender tests contain no identical repeated case and explicitly cover default 1281-byte receiver behavior plus valid/invalid normative maximum receiver limits.
